what_happened: Two Astra passes for KALA World Bible v3 both hit the max_completion_tokens cap and truncated. Pass1 (cap15500) produced WORLD-01..06 with WORLD-06 cut mid-bullet. Pass2 (cap9000) produced WORLD-06..10 with WORLD-10 cut mid-sentence.
root_cause: Prompt asked the model to expand ten dense fact-sheet sections (target 55-65k chars) but set an output cap sized for far less; the model over-expanded early sections and ran out of tokens before finishing. Cap was under-provisioned relative to the requested output length.
impact: Deliverable completed by stitching two runs; WORLD-06 recovered from pass2; only WORLD-10s final sentence was lost (trimmed cleanly). Spend .250 vs ~.0 budget (~25% over).
corrective_action: Next bulk-generation task: size max_completion_tokens from the requested output length (or split into per-section tasks) instead of a fixed small cap; instruct a per-section length budget to cap over-expansion.
